list.title: Big goals
list.intro: Plans that run for weeks or months. Study time comes from the goal you link.
list.emptyBody: A roadmap breaks a big goal into weeks or stages, tracks what you've finished, and counts the time you log on a goal you link. Start empty, or load the 21-week QPT plan.

notFound.title: Big goal not found
notFound.body: This roadmap doesn't exist anymore. It may have been deleted on another device.

pace.subWarn: Use a spare week or day to catch up.
pace.subCrit: Consider moving your planned dates or milestone.
pace.subEmpty: Add items while editing the roadmap to start tracking.

detail.noItemsBody: Add phases and items to start tracking this roadmap.

overview.label: Overview
overview.hoursOutsideBefore: Includes {{hours}} from before the roadmap's start date.
overview.hoursOutside: Includes {{hours}} from days that fall outside every item.
overview.hoursNone: Link a goal to count study time.
overview.hoursArchived: The linked goal is archived. Its time still counts.

howHours.body: The total is everything logged on the linked goal, the same figure the goal's page shows. An item's hours include only the days counted for it, and each day counts for one item: the one you've started or finished on that date, otherwise the one whose planned dates include it. A day that falls in no item isn't added to any item, but it still counts in the total.

new.title: New roadmap
new.afterCreate: After you create the roadmap, you can add phases, items and checkpoints.

ed.noteHint: Shown as plain text on the roadmap. Good for a weekly routine.
ed.goalHint: Study time is counted from this goal's entries. Archived goals and goals already used by another roadmap aren't listed.
ed.goalMissing: The linked goal was deleted. Choose another goal, or leave this empty.
ed.goalNoGoals: You have no goals to link yet.
ed.targetHint: Steps of 0.5, from 0.5 to 168. Used for the plan-to-date and this-week figures.
ed.milestoneHint: Shows a countdown on the roadmap.
ed.noPhases: No phases yet. Add a phase, then add items to it.
ed.itemDatesHint: We suggested 7 days right after the last item. Change them if you need to.
ed.deleteRoadmapBody: This deletes the roadmap with its {{phases}}, {{items}} and {{checkpoints}}. Your goal and its entries are not affected. This can't be undone.
ed.deleteRoadmapBodyEmpty: This deletes the roadmap. Your goal and its entries are not affected. This can't be undone.
ed.deletePhaseBody_one: This deletes the phase and its {{count}} item. This can't be undone.
ed.deletePhaseBody_other: This deletes the phase and its {{count}} items. This can't be undone.
ed.deletePhaseBodyEmpty: This deletes the empty phase. This can't be undone.
ed.deleteItemBody: This deletes the item with its dates and note. This can't be undone.
ed.deleteCpBody: This deletes the checkpoint and its score. This can't be undone.
